metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Gobi Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Terra AOD product (MOD08_M3) for monthly aerosol optical depth - Date: February 2019 vs February 2020 - Location: Gobi Desert (approximately 42°N, 105°E, spanning parts of Mongolia and China) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for AOD monthly products - AOD is what we're measuring directly - May need to check for valid pixel counts 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: AOD can legitimately be near 0 (very clear atmosphere) - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: If AOD values are None, NaN, or outside valid range (AOD typically 0-5, rarely >3) - A: If 2020 AOD > 2019 AOD - B: If 2020 AOD <= 2019 AOD ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Gobi Desert approximate extent gobi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[100, 38], [110, 38], [110, 46], [100, 46], [100, 38]] ]) # 2. Data Acquisition & Check # Using MODIS Terra Monthly AOD product col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_M3') \ .filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-03-01') \ .filterBounds(gobi) col_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_M3') \ .filterDate('2020-02-01', '2020-03-01') \ .filterBounds(gobi) size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo() size_2020 = col_2020.size().getInfo() print(f"2019 Images: {size_2019}") print(f"2020 Images: {size_2020}") if size_2019 == 0 or size_2020 == 0: print("Missing data for one or both periods.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Get AOD values # Use AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined band img_2019 = col_2019.first() img_2020 = col_2020.first() aod_band = 'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean_Mean_Mean' # Check pixel counts count_2019 = img_2019.select(aod_band).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=gobi, scale=111320, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(aod_band).getInfo() count_2020 = img_2020.select(aod_band).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=gobi, scale=111320, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(aod_band).getInfo() print(f"2019 Valid Pixels: {count_2019}") print(f"2020 Valid Pixels: {count_2020}") if count_2019 == 0 or count_2020 == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") else: # 4. Calculation - Mean AOD aod_2019 = img_2019.select(aod_band).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=gobi, scale=111320, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(aod_band).getInfo() aod_2020 = img_2020.select(aod_band).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=gobi, scale=111320, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(aod_band).getInfo() print(f"2019 Mean AOD: {aod_2019}") print(f"2020 Mean AOD: {aod_2020}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if aod_2019 is None or aod_2020 is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") elif aod_2019 < 0 or aod_2019 > 5 or aod_2020 < 0 or aod_2020 > 5: print("AOD values outside valid range.") print("C3") elif aod_2020 > aod_2019: print(f"2020 AOD ({aod_2020:.4f}) > 2019 AOD ({aod_2019:.4f})") print("A") else: print(f"2020 AOD ({aod_2020:.4f}) <= 2019 AOD ({aod_2019:.4f})") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Gobi Desert approximate extent
gobi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[100, 38], [110, 38], [110, 46], [100, 46], [100, 38]]
])

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
# Using MODIS Terra Monthly AOD product
col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_M3') \
    .filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-03-01') \
    .filterBounds(gobi)

col_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_M3') \
    .filterDate('2020-02-01', '2020-03-01') \
    .filterBounds(gobi)

size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo()
size_2020 = col_2020.size().getInfo()

print(f"2019 Images: {size_2019}")
print(f"2020 Images: {size_2020}")

if size_2019 == 0 or size_2020 == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both periods.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Get AOD values
    # Use AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined band
    img_2019 = col_2019.first()
    img_2020 = col_2020.first()
    
    aod_band = 'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean_Mean_Mean'
    
    # Check pixel counts
    count_2019 = img_2019.select(aod_band).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=gobi,
        scale=111320,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(aod_band).getInfo()
    
    count_2020 = img_2020.select(aod_band).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=gobi,
        scale=111320,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(aod_band).getInfo()
    
    print(f"2019 Valid Pixels: {count_2019}")
    print(f"2020 Valid Pixels: {count_2020}")
    
    if count_2019 == 0 or count_2020 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculation - Mean AOD
        aod_2019 = img_2019.select(aod_band).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=gobi,
            scale=111320,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(aod_band).getInfo()
        
        aod_2020 = img_2020.select(aod_band).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=gobi,
            scale=111320,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(aod_band).getInfo()
        
        print(f"2019 Mean AOD: {aod_2019}")
        print(f"2020 Mean AOD: {aod_2020}")
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if aod_2019 is None or aod_2020 is None:
            print("Calculation returned None.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif aod_2019 < 0 or aod_2019 > 5 or aod_2020 < 0 or aod_2020 > 5:
            print("AOD values outside valid range.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif aod_2020 > aod_2019:
            print(f"2020 AOD ({aod_2020:.4f}) > 2019 AOD ({aod_2019:.4f})")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"2020 AOD ({aod_2020:.4f}) <= 2019 AOD ({aod_2019:.4f})")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
